author: agam-instinct
title: Solar matches: long-run share growth
hypothesis: Solar matches have a higher share of archive stories in the latest six months than the first six.
expect: Ratio at least 1.5x strongly supports, at least 1.1x weakly supports; at or below 0.9x refutes. Between is inconclusive.
caveats: Full-history archive, Jan 2023-Jun 2026 after conservative endpoint exclusion. First/last six complete-month mean share; denominators from same archive, not independently verified all-HN coverage.
Provider matches case-insensitive whole words in title PLUS text; these are not the same title-only topic proxies used in h100-h114.

Points are archive capture snapshots, not current final scores. Collection-age bias and missing/partial retrieval may affect levels. No adoption, readership, technical validity, mainstream lead or investment-return inference.
Thresholds fixed in docs/vcs-history-plan.md before inspecting these aggregate results. Strong/weak are rule labels, not statistical confidence intervals.
Solar includes astronomy/eclipses and other contexts. solar_eclipse overlap cannot safely be subtracted from separate marginal counts. This is not a clean solar-energy test.
